record.field: The lines are created again from the current equipment and the line filter of the inspection type; entries in the lines are lost.
Sets all check items not yet answered of the header and of the lines with access to OK (resp. Yes); answered items are kept.
Sets all check items not yet answered of the line to OK (resp. Yes) and fills empty quantities and the visit date; answered items are kept.
The approval is taken back; the archived report is kept as attachment marked withdrawn.
Windows and doors of common areas close properly
No combustible storage in escape routes
Heating and meter rooms accessible and locked
House rules, emergency numbers and caretaker contact posted
All required rooms equipped (bedrooms, children's rooms, corridors as escape routes)
Detectors mounted correctly (ceiling, distance to walls and obstacles)
Smoke inlets free, not painted over or covered
Earliest replacement date of the installed detectors
Arrange the date with the caretaker
Arrange the date of the walkthrough with the caretaker, enter it as planned date of the inspection and note participants and access to technical rooms.
Walk through the building along the checklist of the inspection, record every item, take photos of findings and complete the inspection ("Done"). The step is done with the inspection.
Check the report and approve the inspection ("Approve"); the report is archived. The step is done with the approval.
Commission the repair of the defects found (tab "Defects" of the inspection), enter the contractor as responsible and follow the deadlines.
Commission the contractor / fix the date
Commission the contractor (or the caretaker), fix the date and the time window and enter them in the inspection (planned date, time slots, contractor).
Create the tenant notice with "Execute Action" and post it in the building at least 14 days before the date. The notice is archived as proof; the step is done with the action.
Create the letters to the tenants without access with "Execute Action" and send them; then set the next attempt ("Next Attempt").
Complete the results, attach the report of the contractor if any and complete the inspection ("Done"). The step is done with the inspection.
Check the report and approve the inspection ("Approve"); the report is archived. The step is done with the approval.
Duty to maintain traffic safety (§ 823 BGB)
State building code (e.g. § 48 (4) BauO Bln), DIN 14676-1

Check the smoke detectors of every apartment and record access, visit date, quantities and the check items per line; for apartments without access note "No Access" with the visit date. The step is done as soon as every line has a visit date.

Check the apartments without access at the first attempt (after "Next Attempt") and record the results with the visit date; apartments still without access need a reason in the remarks. The step is done as soon as these lines have a visit date again.
